name: dyn_accessor_inverse
source:
{ The live accessor: the analytic solver sizes an ODE input (the cooling
  coefficient k) so the transient hits a target. This is the second-solve pass. }
Tinf = 20
Temp0 = 95

FinalValue('Temp') = 30

DYNAMIC cooling (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 60, points = 21)
  der(Temp) = -k*(Temp - Tinf)
  Temp(0) = Temp0
END

error.message: There are 3 equations and 2 variables. The problem is overspecified and cannot be solved. Redundant relation (no free variable left to determine): FinalValue('Temp')=30. A common cause: the same physics stated twice — a boundary pinning a quantity a component already defines (a re-equated mixer pressure, a T-pinned wall state), or two property calls restating one relation.
